header.title: Project Results & Educational Resources
header.subtitle: All resources produced under the Erasmus+ Green Horizon partnership are published as Open Educational Resources (OER) under Creative Commons CC BY-SA 4.0.

result_1_booklet.title: Educational Booklet on Drone Operation, Photography and Climate Change Mitigation
result_1_booklet.description: The Green Horizon Educational Booklet is a practical handbook co-created by youth workers from Germany, Romania, and Türkiye. It combines climate change mitigation concepts, photography composition, and drone operation safety rules into an accessible guide.

result_2_documentaries.title: Youth Climate Campaign Documentary Series
result_2_documentaries.subtitle: Three short awareness films filmed, narrated, and produced by youth teams in Germany, Romania, and Türkiye.

films.title: Reduce & Reconnect: Aerial Perspectives & Youth Eco-Action in Bonn
films.description: Youth participants in Bonn capture aerial drone views of urban lake ecosystems and parklands, raising smartphone banners to advocate for conscious consumption (“REDUCE”) and Erasmus+ youth-led climate responsibility.

films.title: Stop Water Contamination: Aerial Guardians of Carpathian Valleys
films.description: Romanian youth teams deploy camera drones above mountain parklands in Brașov, pairing sweeping canopy views with an urgent on-camera call to safeguard freshwater reserves and stop water contamination.

films.title: Stop Plastic Waste: Youth Recycling & Circular Action in Mersin
films.description: Young advocates in Mersin take to public spaces with grassroots campaign signs—“RECYCLE” and “STOP PLASTIC WASTE”—highlighting the daily battle against single-use plastics and mobilizing youth for circular waste management.

result_3_exhibition.title: VR-Enhanced Photo Exhibition: Climate Landscapes from Above
result_3_exhibition.meta: Online since June 2026 • Presented at Conferences July 2026
result_3_exhibition.description: An interactive 3D virtual reality exhibition space displaying drone photography, environmental field portraits, and behind-the-scenes youth actions across partner regions.
